finding.title: Password-protected share metadata leaks project details

currentRepoProof.head: 8af2af8fcd088a564cf6af4a0e703039042fc349
sourceControls: src/app/share/[token]/page.tsx generateMetadata calls resolveProjectPublicationAccessByToken(token) before any snapshot read.
generateMetadata returns protectedPublicationMetadata when access.passwordRequired is true.
protectedPublicationMetadata contains only generic title/description/openGraph values and omits project name, project code, client name, counts, totals, and images.

graphProof.result: generateMetadata content shows the access.passwordRequired branch returning protectedPublicationMetadata before resolveProjectPublicationSnapshotByToken(token).

dashboardProof.submittedContext: Current main fixes this by resolving publication access before share metadata snapshot reads. In src/app/share/[token]/page.tsx, generateMetadata calls resolveProjectPublicationAccessByToken(token) first and returns protectedPublicationMetadata when access.passwordRequired is true, before resolveProjectPublicationSnapshotByToken(token). That generic metadata contains only "Proposal Review | Archestimator" and "This proposal is password protected." and omits project name, code, client, counts, totals, and images. Finding was against old commit 56dbd00; current main is 8af2af8.
